rows.Name and Construction Contract Number: Garrison Creek Sanitary Separation Study & Strachan Sewage Pumping Station Environmental Assessment Study
rows.Scope of Work: Detailed Description: Feasibility study and conceptual design for separating storm and sanitary flows within the Garrison Creek and Strachan Sewage Pumping Station catchment. The study will identify candidate separation locations, develop cost estimates, and quantify net benefits for each option to inform subsequent capital planning and the Strachan SPS Environmental Assessment.

rows.Name and Construction Contract Number: Smoke and Dye Testing Phase 3
rows.Scope of Work: Detailed Description: Field investigation program using smoke and dye testing on sanitary and storm sewer pipes within the Phase 3 study area to identify sources of inflow and infiltration. Findings will inform downstream rehabilitation prioritization and capital planning for inflow and infiltration reduction.

rows.Name and Construction Contract Number: Humber Treatment Plant South Primary Tank Long and Cross Collector Replacements - 26ECS-MI-02HU
